name: Perovskite and tandem solar cells
principle: A perovskite layer is added on top of a silicon cell (tandem) or used alone to capture more of the spectrum than silicon can. NREL's 2024 baseline assumes advanced-scenario modules sit midway between TOPCon/SHJ and tandem technology. The Oxford PV page read did not carry current tandem efficiency or shipment data.

process_steps.name: Deposit perovskite layers on a silicon or glass substrate

source.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Perovskite thin film' 6 (2025)

advantages: Higher efficiency ceiling than single-junction silicon
limitations: Durability and stability are the open issues

sources.note: NREL Annual Technology Baseline 2024, utility-scale PV, read 25 October 2026
